_note: Story events for Levant Ablaze, the modern Syria campaign (sortie ODFv2). Spliced into the campaign config by Missions/Vector/Syria/tools/build_cfg.py. Every event is set off by something players or the AI do, never by a clock, and fires once per round. Objective names are the mission's (Syria/tools/syria_oob.py). The public site and the wiki show the same events (shared/servers/syria.ts); change both together. Placeholders in text: {by} (who caused it). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

events.title: The shield goes blind
events.text: {by} have knocked out the Air Defence Academy. Batteries from Homs to Aleppo, the coast and the Euphrates lose their cueing and start fighting on their own.

events.title: The 159th falls silent
events.text: The coalition's second command post is gone after a strike by {by}. What is left of the network fights blind.

events.title: Incirlik under attack
events.text: NATO's headquarters at Incirlik is down after a strike led by {by}. The Alliance's batteries in Turkey lose their picture.

events.title: Naqoura line broken
events.text: {by} have broken the Naqoura line on the coast. The road north into Lebanon is open.

events.title: The Galilee breached
events.text: Coalition troops under {by} are in Kiryat Shmona. NATO's southern front falls back on Rosh Pina.

Message.text: Kiryat Shmona has fallen. Hold Rosh Pina.

events.title: Taftanaz taken
events.text: {by} have taken Taftanaz. Aleppo is next.

events.title: Aleppo falls
events.text: Aleppo is in NATO hands, {by} among the crews credited. The factories of the northern belt are behind the line.

events.title: Hatay lost
events.text: The coalition has pushed into Hatay behind {by}. Gaziantep becomes NATO's front line in the north.

events.title: Sharqiyah Mine hit
events.text: {by} have put the Sharqiyah Mine out of action. The coalition's Euphrates industry is next.

events.title: The Euphrates burns
events.text: With Sharqiyah already down, strikes flown by {by} have put Durayhim out of action too. The coalition's Euphrates industry is finished.

events.title: Latakia closed
events.text: The coalition's only naval base is out of the war after {by} struck it. The sea belongs to NATO.

events.title: Damascus cut off
events.text: {by} have taken the Damascus hub. Every coalition unit south of it fights with what it carries.
